answer: Sybil resistance follows from reputation’s exponential temporal half-life: an identity must sustain honest, reciprocated service over time or its score decays rapidly. In EigenTrust matrix factorization, reciprocity-weighted transitivity propagates credit through established peers, while a freshly spawned sybil has near-zero eigenvector centrality; its echo, harbor, or tundra of colluding accounts therefore cannot accumulate enough trusted mass to pass consensus.
